start: A member's page, member has a photo; gym has a logo

steps.action: Open the member card
user_sees: A sheet 'Member card' with the card: gym name and logo, 'MEMBER CARD', photo, member number, QR, mobile with some digits hidden
Buttons 'Print', 'Download picture', 'Send on WhatsApp'
must_not: Another gym's logo or colour
The full mobile number on the card

steps.action: Tap 'Print'
user_sees: The browser's print page with only the card, at ATM-card size on A4, with a cut line
must_not: The whole member page printed
An empty print page on phone Chrome

steps.action: Tap 'Download picture'
user_sees: A PNG lands in downloads; the words 'Card saved as a picture.'
must_not: 'Card saved as a picture.' when no file was made
A picture without the photo or QR that the screen shows

steps.action: Tap 'Send on WhatsApp'
user_sees: WhatsApp opens on the member's own number with the card message typed; the person attaches the picture
must_not: A message sent by itself
The chat opened on a number other than the member's

start: The 'Member card' sheet; the browser cannot make the picture

steps.action: Tap 'Download picture'
user_sees: 'Could not make the picture. Try Print.'
must_not: A silent nothing
A blank or half-drawn picture saved

steps.action: Open the sheet with the internet off
user_sees: A plain card with the gym name, no logo
must_not: A broken-picture mark or an endless wait

start: The 'Member card' sheet for a member with no photo, then one whose photo link is dead

steps.action: Open the card of the member with no photo
user_sees: Their initials in the photo box
must_not: An empty box

steps.action: Open the card of the member with a dead photo link
user_sees: Initials again
must_not: A broken-picture mark

steps.action: Close the sheet and open it again
user_sees: The same card; nothing was saved by looking
must_not: A changed member record

steps.action: Read the small print, then scan the card's QR with a plain camera app
user_sees: 'The QR has only the member’s ID, not their name or phone number. Some digits of the mobile number are hidden.'
The scan shows an ID only
must_not: Name or mobile number inside the QR
The full number in the downloaded picture or the WhatsApp text
